higgsfield.prompt: Cinematic urban-grit Love Hurts campaign in The Fractured Chamber, reimagined as an abandoned civic transit hall after midnight. One founder-approved customer in the exact LH-003 shorts stands left at product-readable scale; preserve exactly four zippered pockets, two side and two back, with a zipper on every pocket. Fractured black marble, raw concrete, aged steel, damp satin floor, red emergency practical light, cold ambient spill, deep detailed shadows, restrained film grain, believable contact and occlusion. higgsfield.brand_context: Love Hurts is controlled romantic urban cinema: defiance inside fractured civic architecture, red emergency light, enchanted drama, customer dignity, and exact luxury streetwear product clarity.
higgsfield.product_context: Preserve the exact LH-003 four-view construction without mirroring. The shorts use white perforated mesh with an all-over orange-red rose-bouquet-on-cloud field, a black ribbed waistband, and angular black leg binding traced by red and white stripes. Pocket topology is invariant: exactly four zippered pockets total, comprising two side hand pockets and two rear pockets; every pocket must visibly retain its zipper closure. The wearer-left front/side carries the large red Love Hurts script and a black-mesh inset with the smaller Love Hurts rose/heart emblem. The wearer-right black-mesh inset carries the embroidered red rose bouquet with green stems and a white-and-blue cloud. The back has two black-trimmed zippered rear pockets plus a large red-and-black wearer-left Love Hurts treatment. Do not render open welts, zipperless pockets, cargo pockets, patch pockets, or any extra pocket.
